subject: Renewal + expansion: tiered uplift options and invoice cadence
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@vectra.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion ask — doubling tokens midterm and co-term question

Hi Marcus / Naomi,

Quick context: we had a usage spike in July and now expect to double our committed token usage for two quarters while onboarding a new feature. We want to understand options to: 
- add uplift capacity mid-contract (Sep–Dec)
- co-term the uplift to align with our existing Jan 1 renewal rather than creating a standalone 3-month add-on invoice

What pricing levers do you recommend? We prefer predictable spend and would consider an annualized top-up or an accelerated commit voucher if that preserves a simple invoice cadence. Also, is there any flexibility on short-term onboarding credits?

Procurement timeline: we need approved commercial terms and a PO by Sep 14 to hit our internal deployment dates.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform, Vectra AI
Elena.Ruiz@vectra.ai

--
Attachment: usage-report-july.csv (referenced)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@vectra.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion ask — doubling tokens midterm and co-term question

Hi Elena — thanks for the clarity and timeline. High-level options we can move quickly on (details attached):

1) Short-term uplift (monthly top-up)
   - Add the incremental units as a monthly top-up at list price minus a 5% uplift discount.
   - Separate invoice for the months used; no changes to the Jan 1 renewal.

2) Annualize mid-contract (preferred for predictability)
   - Annualize the uplift across the remaining term (Oct 1–Jan 1) and convert to a temporary committed bucket.
   - 10% uplift discount for annualizing; invoice can be pro-rated onto your Jan 1 renewal (single invoice on co-term) or charged as a one-off depending on PO/cashflow.

3) Accelerated-commit voucher (tradeoff model)
   - You pre-pay an accelerated commit that guarantees capacity for the next 12 months at a blended rate; we can offer a 15% effective discount for a voucher equal to 3x the uplift for the quarter. This preserves a single invoice cadence and provides the deepest discount, but requires commitment.

Onboarding credits: we can provide a modest onboarding credit (equivalent to 5k tokens) if we have CS commit to a condensed enablement plan (2 weeks).

I attached a quick quote and a mutual action plan that maps milestones to PO and DocuSign. If any of these options looks promising I’ll loop in finance to lock the payment terms and get a DocuSign link ready.

Attachments:
- Q3-Expansion-Quote-v1.pdf
- MutualActionPlan.xlsx

Action items:
- Elena: confirm preferred option by Tue Sep 8 (to meet PO deadline)
- Naomi/Ben: if accepted, can we pre-approve the 10% annualize discount or 15% voucher on a case-by-case basis?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0129

--

Subject: Re: Expansion ask — doubling tokens midterm and co-term question

Looping in a quick note from sales ops perspective:
- Confirmed current committed units for Vectra are 2.5B tokens / year. Elena is asking for ~+2.5B for the quarter (effectively doubling).
- If we pursue the voucher path (option 3) we need an internal approval threshold for >10% effective discount; otherwise finance wants to stay at 10% cap for annualized mid-term adjustments.

Proposal: recommend pushing option 2 (annualize) as primary — it hits their ask for co-terming and keeps cashflow predictable. Offer option 3 (voucher) as a secondary if they can sign a PO that supports pre-pay.

Ben

Quick internal: I approve a one-time exception to allow up to 15% effective discount for the accelerated voucher if the customer signs an annualized pre-pay (option 3). Conditions:
- Voucher term must be 12 months and non-refundable.
- CS must commit to the 2-week enablement plan in the MutualActionPlan.xlsx and confirm onboarding window by Sep 21.
- Finance to accept a 30-day net invoice on the pro-rated annualize path (option 2) only if procurement provides a PO that references DEAL-8741.

If Elena confirms option 2 (annualize and co-term) we should prepare a pro-forma invoice that can be rolled into the Jan 1 renewal to avoid separate month-to-month invoicing. Naomi — please coordinate with billing.

Hannah

Marcus — thanks, this helps. We reviewed internally and are comfortable moving forward with option 2 (annualize the uplift across Oct 1–Jan 1 and roll pro-rata into the Jan 1 renewal). A few cleanups before we sign:

1) Please confirm the pro-forma invoice will show the charge as a single line-item for the uplift and reference our existing PO template. We will need net-30 payment terms.
2) Please include a one-time onboarding credit of 5k tokens in the final quote (you referenced this as contingent on a 2-week enablement plan — we accept).
3) DocuSign request: please send the amended quote + amendment to master subscription for signature.

If we can get the DocuSign by Sep 9 we can route it through procurement and hit the Sep 14 PO deadline.

Thanks,
